## 🏥 About Bhagwati Medicare (नेपालको #१ मेडिकल सप्लायर)

**Bhagwati Medicare Pvt. Ltd.** is Nepal's premier authorized importer, distributor, and 24/7 rental hub for medical equipment, surgical instruments, hospital furniture, ICU setup machinery, and diagnostic supplies. Located centrally in **Tripureshwor, Kathmandu**, Bhagwati Medicare serves hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, and residential homecare patients across all 77 districts of Nepal.

### 🌟 Why Bhagwati Medicare Ranks #1 in Nepal
- **दैनिक २०,०००+ अर्डर (High Volume Trust):** Serving thousands of verified patients and medical institutions daily.
- **सस्तो सामान (Factory Direct Pricing):** Wholesale and direct-importer rates beating third-party retail markups.
- **१००% प्रिमियम क्वालिटी (100% Genuine & Certified):** Authorized stockist for World Top Medical Brands including Philips Healthcare, Yuwell, Omron, Microlife, ResMed, Contec, and Sinocare.
- **२ घण्टामा आपतकालीन डेलिभरी (2-Hour Emergency Delivery):** Rapid dispatch across Kathmandu, Lalitpur, and Bhaktapur with free bedside installation and technician demonstration.
- **आधिकारिक भ्याट बिल (100% IRD VAT Tax Invoice):** Compliant with Nepal Government Inland Revenue Department standards (PAN: 623669932).
